All reads are translated: each `self.G.subject_objects(P)` is `m{ ?s P ?o }` inside the original `chain(...)`. The stratum sites, 14 `self.G.remove((s, P, o))` over five loops, are all fully bound: `-{ {s} P {o} }`, one island per removal. A `;` fold would be a DELETE WHERE join that removes nothing when one of the three or four triples is absent (the fixture has such subjects, e.g. one with only dc:title).

The removals happen while the chain is still being walked (a value carried by dc:title, skos:prefLabel and dcterms:title on one subject is removed at the first source, so the later generators no longer yield it). m{ } is lazy like the rdflib generator, and the fixture has that subject (ex:l4, ex:c5): same graph on both sides.
`@graph self.G` designates an attribute and adds the six prefixes to the caller's graph without overwriting its bindings; the harness compares bindings and is green.
